configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Configure Unix Makefiles in build/debug with Debug flags. ROOT must already be available. See CMakePresets.json.md.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Inherit the Debug generator, override the build directory and enable Release optimization.

buildPresets.name: debug
buildPresets.description: Build targets in the directory selected by the debug configure preset; does not run samples.

buildPresets.name: release
buildPresets.description: Build targets in the directory selected by the release configure preset; does not run samples.

testPresets.name: debug
testPresets.description: Run registered CTest cases in build/debug and display captured output on failure. Configure BUILD_TESTING=ON first.
